title: Uruguayan Chewy Keto Noodles
description: A unique twist on traditional noodles, this Uruguayan-inspired dish combines chewy texture with keto-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan chorizo
ingredients.notes: Slice into small pieces before cooking

instructions: Dust a baking sheet with rice flour.
Roll out chewy noodles to desired thickness.
Place noodles on prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle grass-fed beef tallow over noodles.
Sprinkle garlic powder, salt, and black pepper over noodles.
Bake in preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until crispy.
Meanwhile, cook Uruguayan chorizo in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking into small pieces as it cooks.
In a separate bowl, beat egg for binding.
Remove noodles from oven and toss with beaten egg to coat.
Add cooked chorizo to noodle mixture and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
